<template>

</template>

<script>
export default {
  name: "Detail",
  data(){
    let goodsId = this.$route.query.id
    return{
      uesr:JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xm-user') || '{}'),
      goodsId: goodsId,
    }
  },
  mounted(){
    this.lodeGoods()
  },
  methods:{
    lodeGoods() {
      this.$request.get('/goods/selectById?id=' + this.goodsId).then(res => {
        if(res.code === '200'){
          this.goodsData = res.data
        }else{
          this.$message.error(res.msg)
        }
      })
    }
  }
}
</script>
